answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, forfeited on duplicate submission, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Every claim climbs the beacon of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the zenith re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the grove of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
